SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
 CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 'web' WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 'training' ELSE 'store' END grp,
 f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) nd, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.etl_loaded_at) l0, max(f.etl_loaded_at) l1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6

WITH w AS (SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_week FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')),
sa AS (SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN f.net_amount END) st_all,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) st_nostaff,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN f.net_amount END) web
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN w ON w.calendar_date=f.sale_date GROUP BY 1,2),
rt AS (SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN r.refund_net END) st_ret,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN r.refund_net END) web_ret,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN r.refund_net END) trn_ret
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN w ON w.calendar_date=r.return_date GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(net_sales) ns, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores, max(store_id) mx
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales p JOIN w ON w.calendar_date=p.business_date GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT * FROM sa JOIN rt USING (fiscal_year,fiscal_week) JOIN rp USING (fiscal_year,fiscal_week) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH fs AS (SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date business_date, sum(f.net_amount) fnet, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT p.business_date, p.store_id, p.net_sales_before_returns, fs.fnet, p.net_sales_before_returns-coalesce(fs.fnet,0) diff, p.receipts, fs.rc
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales p LEFT JOIN fs ON fs.store_id=p.store_id AND fs.business_date=p.business_date
WHERE p.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-01' AND abs(p.net_sales_before_returns-coalesce(fs.fnet,0))>0.01 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date
  FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(r.refund_net) AS amount
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
net AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.amount - coalesce(r.amount, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
),
starts AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, min(fiscal_week_start_date) AS week_start_date FROM wk GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT t.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week, st.week_start_date,
       t.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, l.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
       round((t.net_sales / l.net_sales - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM net t
JOIN net l ON l.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
JOIN starts st ON st.fiscal_year = t.fiscal_year AND st.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week
WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY t.fiscal_week
